## Collaborations and Scale Enquiries

If you are interested in using the DHES in your research, discussing 
collaboration, or would like to be notified when the scale becomes publicly 
available, please get in touch via email.

## Stay Updated

The best way to stay informed about the progress of the DHE project is to 
bookmark this site, which will be updated as new outputs become available.
